name: Progress ring
summary: A circular progress indicator with its value written inside.
description:
Use a progress ring where a bar does not fit: a profile completion badge, storage on a card, an upload on a thumbnail. For long tasks in a form or a page, the straight progress bar reads better.

It is an element with role="progressbar" and the value in --v-value (0 to 100). The ring is drawn in CSS, so it needs no SVG or JS; update --v-value and aria-valuenow together.

classes.name: v-progress-ring
classes.description: The ring. Set --v-value as a number from 0 to 100; put the label (a number or an icon) inside.

classes.name: v-progress-ring-sm
classes.description: Small, for lists and table cells.

classes.name: v-progress-ring-success
classes.description: Success colour, for a finished task.

classes.name: v-progress-ring-warning
classes.description: Warning colour, for a quota nearly used.

classes.name: v-progress-ring-danger
classes.description: Danger colour, for a limit reached.

states.description: The fill, a number from 0 to 100 (style="--v-value: 72").
The same number for assistive tech, with aria-valuemin="0", aria-valuemax="100" and an aria-label.

a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow and a label is what screen readers announce; the ring itself is decoration.
Write the value inside as text too, so it does not depend on reading the arc.
In forced colours the ring switches to system colours so the filled part still shows.
